opening.argument: The video directs viewers to deploy and fund a front-running contract, including an instruction that “the next step in this process is just funding your contract” and a demonstrated contribution of “0.5 bnb – actually might just make it 1.” It presents the contract as automatically buying and selling, while claiming that “It will sell within one minute” and return 90% to the wallet. The description promises viewers can “passively generate thousands a day,” and the speaker claims returns of up to 100 BNB per day with more capital. Although fees may consume deposited money, the material does not establish that the contract works as claimed or that the displayed transaction produced profit.
